seo.title: For Businesses · ChatSched
seo.description: Book real South African publishers and creators directly — no ad account, no bidding, no algorithm. Secure payment, tracked campaigns, proof once it's live.

hero.title: Reach the audience your customers already trust.
hero.subtitle: ChatSched connects South African small businesses directly with the pages, creators and channels their customers already follow — no algorithm, no ad account, no bidding war. You pay only once a real person has confirmed your placement is live.

howItWorks.title: From request to live, in four steps.

steps.title: Find your channel
steps.body: Browse social pages, influencers, websites, podcasts and radio slots by category, province and audience to find the match for your customers.

steps.title: Submit a request
steps.body: Pick a publisher and send a feature request describing what you want to promote — no account manager, no ad account, no minimum spend.

steps.title: Pay securely
steps.body: Once the publisher approves, pay securely by card, instant EFT, or manual EFT. Funds stay in the ChatSched payment flow — not released to the publisher — until the placement is actually live.

steps.title: Get proof, not promises
steps.body: Watch your request move from submitted to live, with proof once it's done. No guessing where your budget went.

channels.title: Book wherever your customers already are.
channels.subtitle: Social pages, creators, websites, podcasts and radio are bookable today — everything else opens as real supply is verified, and you can see the status on every card.

tools.title: A full marketing suite, not just a directory.
tools.subtitle: Once you're registered, these tools live right in your dashboard alongside your requests.

items.name: Audience Finder
items.body: Describe your business in plain language — get a ranked list of publishers who actually fit.

items.name: Reach Planner
items.body: A guided wizard that turns a goal into a plan and a schedule.

items.name: Content Studio
items.body: One photo or brief becomes nine ready-to-post formats — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and more.

items.name: Caption Writer
items.body: Describe the promotion once, get channel-ready captions back — no rewriting for every placement.

items.name: Campaign Builder
items.body: Turn a plain-language brief into a scored campaign, with suggestions to improve it.

items.name: Campaign Tracker
items.body: Real tracking links for every campaign — clicks, visits, leads and conversions, not estimates.

items.name: ROI Calculator
items.body: Put in a budget, get an estimated reach and return before you commit.

items.name: Media Kit
items.body: Build the one-page kit a publisher or partner needs to say yes in a single look.

escrowStrip.title: 🔒 Your payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow
escrowStrip.body: After a campaign is approved, the payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow until the applicable live-placement condition is met. The publisher payout then follows the published payout timeline.

items.q: Do I need a contract or subscription?
items.a: No contract either way. Browsing is always free — sending a request needs a one-time ChatSched Business activation (R399, once-off — no renewal, ever), which also unlocks managed advertising and includes a R199 launch credit.

items.q: How do I know a publisher is legitimate?
items.a: Every publisher and creator is reviewed by hand before they're listed, and carries a visible trust score and level built from real campaign history — not just a follower count.
Once a publisher approves your request, you have {{days}} days to pay. The payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow — not released to the publisher — until the placement is confirmed live.

items.q: What if a publisher doesn't respond?
items.a: Publishers have {{days}} days to approve or decline a request. If it's not actioned in that window, it closes automatically — you're never left waiting indefinitely.
Social media pages and groups, influencers, websites, podcasts and radio slots — all through the same request-and-approve flow.
